item.title: Third defendant sentenced to nearly 25 years for role in Isanti County home invasion homicide
item.description:
Publication Date: October 09, 2025

Abraham Houle sentenced to 297 months in prison for aiding and abetting burglary in the first-degree and aiding an offender after a second-degree murder

item.title: Attorney General Ellison leads joint statement condemning Trump attacks on nonprofits’ freedom of speech and association
item.description:
Publication Date: October 10, 2025

Targeting nonprofits based on ideology is ‘gross violation of First Amendment rights,’ attack on donor intent, and ‘deeply un-American’

https://www.ag.state.mn.us/Office/Communications/2025/10/10_Nonprofits.asp

item.title: Attorney General Ellison supports Oregon’s court fight to stop Trump’s National Guard deployment to Portland
item.description:
Publication Date: October 10, 2025

Joins coalition of 24 attorneys general and governors in amicus brief in Oregon’s lawsuit to stop Trump’s illegal deployment of the military to patrol a peaceful city

https://www.ag.state.mn.us/Office/Communications/2025/10/10_NationalGuard.asp

item.title: Attorney General Ellison and AGs across the country condemn retaliatory prosecution of New York Attorney General Letitia James
item.description:
Publication Date: October 13, 2025

‘These kinds of prosecutorial abuses are the hallmarks of police states and authoritarian regimes—not America’s democracy,’ say 22 AGs in joint statement
